description: Weekly grouped updates, merged once CI passes. The age gate and its exemptions mirror minimumReleaseAge and minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml (src/test/renovate.spec.ts checks). Renovate runs pnpm on the Node version in .nvmrc.

packageRules.description: Same exemptions as minimumReleaseAgeExclude in pnpm-workspace.yaml.
One PR for minor and patch updates. .nvmrc is in the group so it moves together with engines.node.
Actions stay pinned to a commit SHA with a `# vX.Y.Z` comment; Renovate updates both. Digest-only updates (a moved tag) are not merged automatically.
Hold TypeScript on 6.x: vue-tsc/Volar and typescript-eslint can't run on the native TS 7 compiler yet (vuejs/language-tools#5381).
Move Node majors by hand, to LTS lines only: .nvmrc, engines.node, @types/node and the @tsconfig/nodeNN base of tsconfig.node.json change together (src/test/node-version.spec.ts checks).
Overrides are security floors scoped to advisory ranges; review them by hand (AGENTS.md › Commands).
